title: Does what it is designed to do but...
text: Does what it is designed to do but.... The electric cord that plugs the top into the base is extremely hard to insert and remove. The longer I have the unit the harder it has become. The pot does what it is designed to do, so if you're okay with this flaw (I put up with it) it's a descent product.

product_metadata.title: MH943SBS Megahome Heavy Duty Distiller, Glass Collection - 316 Stainless Steel
features: 316 STAINLESS STEEL: The heavy duty Megahome distiller is the only countertop distiller in the world to be manufactured with a 316 grade stainless boil chamber and dome. While the majority of customers are fine with the standard Megahome distillers that come with 304 or 18/8 stainless steel this was a request of some customers and we are proud to offer this special unit.

MAKES THE PUREST WATER: Not all distillers are created equal. Megahome distillers consistently produce cleaner water than competing distillers. Many distillers offer quicker distillation rates but sacrifice the purity of the distilled water being produced because they distill at too high of a temperature. If you are looking for the cleanest and purest water, look no further.

1 YEAR WARRANTY: Top-to-bottom warranty that covers parts and labor. In the unlikely event you have an issue with your Megahome distiller, we (Nutriteam Inc) offer you the best and fastest customer service to keep you up and running. If you need a part, we've got it!

TOP QUALITY PARTS: Megahome distillers are manufactured with the highest quality parts. All parts are manufactured to our precise requirements. Each distiller is QC tested before being boxed and shipped.

UL LISTED: UL (Underwriters Laboratory) is a trusted independent global safety science company that thoroughly tests products to be used in the United States to determine if they comply with important safety standards. Megahome distillers are the only UL approved water distillers available. Do not risk your safety or safety of your family to save a few dollars on a cheaper water distiller.
